news.title: Darline Graham, Backed By Trump, Wins Primary for Senate in South Carolina
news.summary: Ms. Graham, who is temporarily filling the seat long held by her late brother, Senator Lindsey Graham, prevailed in a runoff and will be heavily favored in November.
